author: Nebbsy
body:
The account give away results will be drawn Thursday April 20th 2017.  If you have not entered you may still do so. (Old thread for entering: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/fbc443383 ).

I am drawing the winner of the account 1 week earlier than I had planned. I will no longer be giving away the 'Pepetheassassin' account in the old thread.

The new account:
Username: Stows
[+] Non-cancerous name history
[+] Semi-OG username
[+] No bans on any server
[+] Changeable password and Security questions
[+] Changeable name
[-] The email is not changeable

'Stow' definition: Stows is the plural form of Stow making this a semi name.
verb
3rd person present: stows
  1. pack or store (an object) carefully and neatly in a particular place.
    "the bathhouse offers baskets in which to stow your clothes"
    synonyms:pack, load, store, place, put (away), deposit, stash
    "Barney stowed her bags in the trunk" 


Although the email is not changeable the account is still %100 secure and yours forever.

Links: 
Name MC: https://namemc.com/profile/Stows.1
Avicus: https://avicus.net/Stows

Winner of the account will be posted here for all to see. I will also PM you on skype if you have me added.

$*#@--> WINNER Someone. They'd rather keep secret  <--@#*$

Good luck to all 17 entries. Sorry about the account being switched!
